notes: Read SKILL.md (244 lines) and benchmark-checklist.md (490 lines) in full. The skill reviews AWS infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, policy JSON) against CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 recommendation IDs using Glob/Grep patterns and Terraform snippets, then writes a scored findings report.

Read-only (allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob); no commands, installs or network access. SKILL.md:84-85 tells the agent to locate `**/.aws/config` and `**/.aws/credentials`, so it may open an AWS credentials file if one is committed in the reviewed tree; flagging a committed credentials file is within the review's purpose, and nothing instructs printing or transmitting keys, but users should expect the agent to see them (hence credentials=true).

License/accuracy note: benchmark-checklist.md reproduces CIS recommendation IDs and one-line titles (e.g. :11-:472) plus abbreviated metric-filter key elements (:381-397); rationale, audit and remediation text from the CIS Benchmark is not copied, so this was judged titles/paraphrase rather than substantial verbatim text. Recommendation 1.3 is skipped and the 62-count is asserted rather than covered. SKILL.md:211 links ../../../schemas/finding.schema.json, used only when JSON output is requested.
Lead reviewer: rated medium because SKILL.md:84-85 globs for **/.aws/credentials, so the agent may open a committed AWS credentials file while reviewing; nothing tells it to print or send the keys.
